name: Chaos Gnome
printedArtCredit: Ron Spencer, unnamed Chaos Gnome, p. 87.
sourceDistinctions: Luck of Chaos is one reroll of the gnome’s own roll, before the DM announces its result. The gnome keeps the reroll.
Spell Power applies to chaos-descriptor spells. The encounter cards distinguish the racial bonus from the Chaos domain bonus.
Entropic shield is available at any Charisma and stays at caster level 1. The other three daily spell-like abilities require Charisma 10 or higher.
The playable entry gives level adjustment +1 and supplies no racial Hit Dice. The staged NPCs and provisional CRs are original.
portraitForm: Orrin Redwick, an original Chaos Gnome Sorcerer
